marksman.label: Marksman
marksman.note: Puts the shot where the gunnery rating says they should, and then a little better.

snap_shot.label: Snap Shot
snap_shot.note: Fires on the move without the usual apology for it. Rare, and worth what it costs.

butcher.label: Butcher
butcher.note: Knows where a hull comes apart and aims for the seam rather than the middle.

cool_hand.label: Cool Hand
cool_hand.note: Runs the reactor past where the manual stops giving advice, and gets away with it.

evasive.label: Evasive
evasive.note: Never quite where the last volley was aimed. Exhausting to fly with, worse to shoot at.

spotter.label: Spotter
spotter.note: Reads a sensor return three seconds before the return resolves. Sees first, every time.

hard_to_kill.label: Hard To Kill
hard_to_kill.note: Has walked out of two hulls that nobody else walked out of. Nobody asks how any more.

quick_study.label: Quick Study
quick_study.note: Debriefs like a machine and comes back to the next drop having actually changed something.

veteran.label: Veteran
veteran.note: Has done this for long enough that nothing on the field is new, including being shot at.

green.label: Green
green.note: Two simulator hours and a contract. Learns fast, mostly because everything is a lesson.
